assets.prompt:
Use configured gpt-image-2.5.
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: single premium e-commerce campaign bitmap, square composition.
Create a bold, richly art-directed sports campaign called folded velocity, with absolutely NO lettering in the image.
A complete unbranded cobalt blue and pearl white technical running shoe, highly convincing mesh, rubber tread and layered sculpted sole, is captured bursting diagonally upward through a sculptural folded racetrack. Shoe in three-quarter view, toe toward lower left, heel toward upper right, clear and fully visible, occupying about 58% of frame width, contained inside central 70% safe zone.
The racetrack is a dramatic architectural ribbon of cobalt rubber with fine white lane stripes, folded into angular switchbacks from distant upper background to near lower foreground, never forming a circle or pedestal. One vermilion-orange track segment slices behind the heel; thinner orange acceleration slivers echo the sole direction. Multiple suspended rubber track shards with crisp bevels and tactile pores, a few speed slices, white translucent aerodynamic sheets and small controlled flecks establish three depth layers. A bright pale sky-blue architectural void behind gives separation. Foreground lower corners can contain large slightly defocused track sections, do not obscure shoe.
Premium commercial CGI + extreme-detail product photography, exuberant and visually rich yet decisively composed, physically plausible materials, hard directional editorial light, deep cobalt shadows, radiant white highlights, punchy cobalt and orange contrast. Dynamic wide-angle environmental perspective with distortion-free product. No generic floating product on round plinth, no rings, no logos, no text, no watermark, no UI, no people. Entire shoe intact and uncut, enough margins for square or portrait crops. Generate one standalone finished image.
assets.revision_prompt: Use configured gpt-image-2.5. Edit this sports campaign image. Preserve its shoe design, cobalt blue/white/orange palette, folded angular rubber race track, dynamic diagonal pose, lighting, materials, speed slices and premium CGI style. Change ONLY framing and spatial composition: pull the camera back substantially, making the WHOLE shoe about 62% of canvas width (current shoe is much too large at ~82%). Center the shoe, with its complete silhouette between 19% and 81% horizontally, and between 25% and 76% vertically. Extend the existing rich folded race track architecture into the newly visible outer margin. Keep the shoe photorealistic and detailed, clear separation, no round plinth. Single square image. No logos, text, watermarks or UI. Product absolutely must remain fully inside centered 70% crop; generously smaller hero is required. Do not crop any part of shoe.

assets.prompt:
Use configured gpt-image-2.5.
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: one square premium skincare advertising campaign bitmap.
Create an extravagant yet exquisitely controlled surreal beauty scene, a luminous liquid botanical cathedral, entirely without lettering.
A large single luxurious unbranded ice-blue glass serum bottle with a finely brushed silver pump cap is the unmistakable hero. It stands at a slight 8-degree tilt and fills 55% of image height, completely contained within central 70% of canvas, with pristine thick glass, luminous liquid, exquisitely resolved condensation and sculpted shoulders. Do not make a tiny bottle. No cream jars.
A monumental transparent water sculpture rises around and behind it like two irregular twisting petals of fluid, NOT a ring, arch, circle, or pedestal. Freeze fine liquid filaments and droplets mid motion; show realistic refraction and caustic light. A large billowing coral-pink peony petal intersects the background like silk, smaller coral petals tumble at different depths. Pearlescent white curved shell fragments and a few luminous pearls sit in foreground shallow water. Liquid sculpture is much larger than the bottle but never obscures its front. Water, petals and translucent frosted-glass planes create differentiated foreground, middle and background. Background softly shifts pale aqua to warm creamy blush, not monochrome blue.
Editorial luxury cosmetics photography fused with hyperreal sculptural CGI, elaborate fashion campaign art direction, sparkling hard rim highlights, rich refracted cyan light, warm coral reflections, delicate champagne rainbow caustics. Clean hero silhouette, no fog covering bottle, not a generic catalog shot. Dramatic sculptural asymmetry, tactile watery detail, expensive restrained specular handling. Keep complete bottle and pump in center-safe zone with generous margins for square or vertical crop. No text, no logo, no watermark, no UI, no people, no round display plinth, no circular halo. One finished standalone image.

Use configured gpt-image-2.5.
Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: single square luxury audio campaign image.
Design a spectacular high-end audio advertisement, make the experience of sound tangible as sculptural architecture. Entirely without lettering.
Hero: one complete unbranded deep midnight-blue over-ear headphone, polished dark anodized aluminum outer earcups, soft richly grained navy cushions, brushed silver yokes, precise hinges, angled in a powerful three-quarter pose. Headphone is center frame and comfortably inside central 70% safe zone, about 57% of canvas height. Keep whole headband, both earcups and hinges legible, no cut off edges. Product clear with exquisite macro product details.
Build an asymmetrical sculptural sonic canyon around it: thin mirror-polished chrome folded plates sweep away from the headphone in a sequence of wave-shaped accordion fins, alternating with translucent electric-cyan glass sound-wave blades. The fins undulate and bend as actual physical sculptures with varied spacing and heights; make strong spatial perspective converging behind hero. Two saturated amber-orange translucent blades cut through the deep background as warm counterpoint. Foreground includes a large sharp folded chrome prism catching streaks of orange and cyan, with only a few small metallic floating fragments. Midnight navy architectural void in distance with electric cyan light edging; strong foreground/midground/background depth. No circles, concentric rings or round pedestals anywhere. Headphones are suspended between the sculptural sound fins, not sitting above a display plinth.
Commercial photography meets precision luxury 3D, ambitious art direction, dramatic contrast, luminous cyan and hot orange accents on dark blue and chrome, high material fidelity, sharp directional softbox reflections, editorial studio detail, tasteful blooming only on light edges. Elaborate but deliberate forms, hero instantly readable at thumbnail size. No words, logos, UI, watermark, humans, wires, equalizer interface or generic neon tunnel. Generous safe margins, complete product fits a centered portrait crop. One finished standalone image.
